entries.en: hole or crevice in the ground

entries.zh: 地上的洞穴；陷坑、陷阱（竇、陷）
entries.en: holes in the ground; hollows, pits, traps

entries.zh: 锁孔（〔疑〕原件汉字作「封門」，与锁孔义不合，或为「風門」一类之误写/借字）
entries.notes: 西语 cerradura 明确为锁，但汉字「封門」按字面是封门/门缝，释义依赖西语栏推断，故降级存疑。

entries.zh: 葱管；茎秆、葱白一类的中空管（蔥管）
entries.en: the hollow of a stalk, as of an onion or scallion; hollow reed

entries.zh: 漏水滴穿而成的孔；漏空（滴漏之洞）
entries.en: hole made by dripping water, a leak-hole

entries.zh: 笔直的孔洞；直贯之孔（着勢：一直到底）
entries.notes: 「着勢」字面为「正着/一直」，与西语 agujero derecho（直孔）相合但汉字组合非常规，略存推断。

entries.zh: 孔洞及打出孔洞；打成空（动词短语：打穿成洞）
entries.en: hole, and to make one; to punch/beat a hole through
to gouge out, to bore a hole
to bore a hole, to hollow out a hole
to hollow out, to scoop a hole

entries.zh: 凿石成孔；啄成空（啄凿石头穿孔）
entries.en: to bore a hole in stone, by pecking/chiselling

entries.zh: 打一个孔；托一空（戳出一孔）
entries.notes: 「托」字此处取「戳、捅」义依西语 agujerear 及「一空」结构推断。

entries.en: to bore or chisel a hole with a chisel (escoplo)

entries.zh: 穿（已穿通之物）；穿通的、被穿孔的

entries.en: to pierce through, to bore a hole through
